title: ChatCompletionRequest
description: Request body for the Chat Completions API. Some parameters apply only to certain models; unsupported parameters are ignored for the selected model.

model.description: The model to use for chat completion.

messages.description: The conversation so far. System prompt plus user and assistant messages in chronological order.

tool_choice.description: Controls tool invocation. `none`: never call tools; `auto`: model decides (default); `required`: must call a tool. Can also be an object to force a specific tool. Only valid when `tools` is set.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may issue multiple tool calls in one reply. When `false`, at most one tool call per turn.

stream.description: Whether to enable streaming output. When `true`, returns `chat.completion.chunk` objects incrementally.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can output. If not set, the model's internal default limit is used.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum completion tokens, including reasoning and visible output tokens. If not set, the model's internal default limit is used.

temperature.description: Controls randomness in generation. Higher values produce more diverse output; lower values produce more deterministic output.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling. Only tokens with cumulative probability up to `top_p` are considered.

top_k.description: Sample only from the top K most probable tokens. `0` disables it.

min_p.description: Minimum probability threshold relative to the most probable token. Tokens below it are filtered out. `0` disables it.

top_a.description: Dynamic filtering threshold based on the most probable token. `0` disables it.

repetition_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens already present in the input. Above 1 suppresses repetition; below 1 encourages it.

frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens by their frequency in the output so far. Positive values reduce repetition.

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes tokens that have already appeared. Positive values encourage new topics.

stop.description: Stop sequences. Generation stops when any of these strings is encountered.

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility. With the same parameters and model version, output should be as consistent as possible.

reasoning_effort.description: Top-level alias for `reasoning.effort`. If both are set, `reasoning` takes precedence.

verbosity.description: Controls how verbose the reply is.

logit_bias.description: A JSON object mapping token IDs to bias values (-100 to 100), added to the logits before sampling.

logprobs.description: Whether to return the log probabilities of the output tokens.

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position. Requires `logprobs` to be `true`.

user.description: A unique identifier for the end user. Use hashed or pseudonymous identifiers to avoid passing personally identifiable information.

mode.description: `implicit` caches automatically; `explicit` caches only prefixes marked with a cache breakpoint.

ttl.description: How long a cache entry is retained.

previous_response_id.description: The `id` of a previous response, used to chain state across turns.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `assistant`.

content.description: The assistant's text content. May be `null` or omitted when the assistant only produces tool calls.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls generated by the model in a previous turn, replayed verbatim. Only valid when `role` is `assistant`.

CacheControl.description: Prompt caching marker. Sets a cache breakpoint so the stable prefix up to this block can be reused.

ChatContentBlock.description: A content block within a message.

text.description: The text content. Required when `type` is `text`.

image_url.description: Image URL object. Required when `type` is `image_url`.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: The function's parameter definition in JSON Schema format.

strict.description: Whether to enable strict mode. When enabled, generated arguments strictly conform to `parameters`.

ChatFunctionTool.description: A custom function tool, executed by the caller.

type.description: The type of tool. Always `function` for a custom tool.

ChatJsonSchemaSpec.description: JSON Schema specification for structured output. Required when `response_format.type` is `json_schema`.

name.description: A user-defined name for the schema.

strict.description: Whether the model output must strictly conform to the schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema definition object. May contain `type`, `properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties`, etc.

ChatOctenBroadSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_broad_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

ChatOctenSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

ChatReasoningOptions.description: Options for reasoning models. Turns thinking on or off and sets the effort and budget.

enabled.description: Set to `false` to turn off thinking. Overrides `effort` and `max_tokens`.

ChatResponseFormat.description: Controls the output format. Some models may not support structured output and will automatically fall back to `text`.

ChatToolCall.description: A custom function call generated by the model.

index.description: The index of this tool call in the array.

id.description: A unique identifier for this tool call. Referenced by the corresponding `tool` message's `tool_call_id`.

type.description: The type of tool call. Always `function`.

ChatToolCallFunction.description: The function invocation details within a tool call.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to the function, as a JSON string generated by the model.

ChatToolChoiceObject.description: Forces a specific tool. The named tool must be declared in `tools`.

type.description: The type of tool to force.

function.description: The function to call. Required when `type` is `function`.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

ChatToolDefinition.description: A tool definition. One of a custom `function` tool, the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool, or the `octen_search` tool.

DeveloperMessage.description: A developer message. The OpenAI-protocol equivalent of `system` (sent by newer OpenAI SDKs); handled as `system`.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `developer`.

content.description: The content. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

FullContentOptions.description: Controls whether to return the full raw content of each result page.

enable.description: If true, returns full_content for each result.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens of full content included per result.

HighlightOptions.description: Controls highlight extraction from result pages.

enable.description: If true, returns query-relevant highlight in each result.

OctenBroadSearchToolParameters.description: Behavior configuration for the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool. Identical to `octen_search` except it accepts `max_queries` instead of `max_searches`. All parameters are optional and share the same semantics and defaults as the Web Search API.

max_queries.description: Upper bound on the number of sub-queries generated.

OctenSearchToolParameters.description: Behavior configuration for the built-in `octen_search` tool. All parameters are optional and share the same semantics and defaults as the Web Search API. The query is generated automatically by the model; a single request may trigger multiple searches.

max_searches.description: Maximum number of searches allowed in a single request.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `system`.

content.description: The system prompt content. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `tool`.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call this message responds to.

content.description: The tool output, typically a JSON string with the function result.

role.description: The role of the message author. Always `user`.

content.description: The content of the message. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results. The `site:` query operator adds to this list.

exclude_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results. The `-site:` query operator adds to this list. If a domain appears in both `include_domains` and `exclude_domains`, `exclude_domains` takes precedence.

include_text.description: Strings that must appear in the result page text.

exclude_text.description: Strings that must not appear in the result page text.

time_basis.description: Determines which time field is used for time filtering. `published` uses time_published; `crawled` uses time_last_crawled. Results missing this field are excluded when filtering by time.

time_range.description: Relative time window counting back from the current time based on `time_basis`. Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time` — if both are provided, `start_time`/`end_time` take precedence.

start_time.description: Start time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: End time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

language.description: A list of languages to restrict results to, as ISO 639-1 codes. By default, no language filter is applied.

format.description: Controls the formatting of highlight outputs.

safesearch.description: Controls filtering of explicit/adult content. `off` disables filtering; `strict` drops all adult content.

include_images.description: Whether to include images in each result.
